summary: Defined execution-image-pack contract for Firecracker/sandbox/update images with pinned digests, provenance, compatibility, active artifact set awareness and rollback rule.
acceptance_evidence: ExecutionImagePackV1 requires sha256-bound kernel, rootfs, image and provenance digests.
CompatibilityRequirement and Firecracker dependency contract are required.
Firecracker dependency must be optional_read_only, preserving local replay without unsafe host fallback.
active_artifact_set_hash_required=true and explicit rollback_rule are enforced.

commands.summary: 18 ecosystem-filtered runtime contract tests passed, including image pack fail-closed coverage.
Observed AGENTD_HANDOFF_OK, AGENTOS_RUNTIME_ARTIFACTS_OK and runtime manifest sha256 marker.
Release gate passed with QEMU runtime smoke and provenance generation.

blocked_shortcuts: Execution image cannot omit pinned digests or provenance.
Missing Firecracker/KVM cannot fall back to host execution.
Update image cannot ignore active artifact set compatibility.
promotion_impact: Execution images now have a contract suitable for future Firecracker sandbox and A/B update bundle promotion.
